verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents the backend surfaces a coding agent needs. It exposes an OpenAI-compatible API that works with any OpenAI SDK or client, plus the Anthropic Messages API (described as compatible with Claude clients) and the Open Responses API. It also documents tool/function calling across backends, with automatic detection of the tool-call format. missing for 10: documented setup guides for specific coding agents (e.g. which agents are tested and how to configure them), and independent or hands-on confirmation that coding-agent tool-call loops actually work reliably against LocalAI models.
